abstract: Inhibition of DNA synthesis in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells with high thymidine induces differentiation similar to that induced with retinoic acid (RA). The presence of differentiated cells is evident after 15 h of treatment with 2 mM thymidine, during which period DNA synthesis is inhibited 99%. The addition of RA during the period of high thymidine treatment does not increase the amount of differentiation seen at the end of the 15-h treatment, but does increase the amount seen after thymidine is removed. The inhibition of proliferation by low serum concentration does not induce differentiation in the absence of RA. In partially synchronized cultures of F9 cells, the addition of RA alters the pattern of DNA replication during the first third of S phase. If RA is present during this part of S phase, differentiation is evident both morphologically and biochemically during the following cell cycle. Addition of RA during the second half of S phase does not lead to obvious differentiation until after the next cell cycle. These results suggest that particular events during the early replication period of F9 cells are targets for RA action in induction of differentiation of F9 cells.
abstract_ja: 高濃度チミジンでF9胎児性癌細胞のDNA合成を阻害すると、レチノイン酸（RA）によるものと類似した分化が誘導される。高濃度チミジン処理の15時間後には分化細胞が認められ、この期間にDNA合成は99%阻害される。高濃度チミジン処理期間中にRAを加えても、15時間処理終了時の分化量は増加しないが、チミジンを除去した後に加えると分化量が増加する。低血清濃度による増殖抑制はRAがなければ分化を誘導しない。部分的に同調させたF9細胞の培養では、RAの添加によりS期の最初の3分の1のDNA複製パターンが変化する。このS期の時期にRAが存在すると、次の細胞周期において形態学的にも生化学的にも分化が認められる。S期後半にRAを加えても、次の細胞周期を経るまで明らかな分化は認められない。これらの結果は、F9細胞の初期複製期の特定の事象が、分化誘導におけるRA作用の標的であることを示唆する。
